source: Unmodified GitLab d8cedd5, built with the same toolchain for A/B comparison

build.compiler: Microsoft (R) 32-bit C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 13.10.3077 (Visual C++ Toolkit 2003)

toolkit_source.file: Install_Civ4_Microsoft_Windows_SDK_Visual_C_Toolkit.exe (community Inno Setup bundle, unpacked with innoextract; not executed)
toolkit_source.authenticode: none embedded in the 2003 binaries; origin not cryptographically verifiable

platform_sdk.signature: Microsoft Corporation Authenticode on the MSI and CABs; the 8 CABs carrying headers/libraries match their signed digests; the 2005 certificate chain cannot be validated against current roots

bts_sdk.used: Boost-1.32.0 and Python24 headers and import libraries

build.host: wine-9.0 (Ubuntu 9.0~repack-4build3) with a 32-bit prefix on Ubuntu 24.04
build.recipe: toolchain/build_dll.sh: the repository's GNUmakefile, TARGET=release (/O2 /Oy /Oi /G7 /DNDEBUG /DFINAL_RELEASE /MD /GR /Gy /EHsc; link /LARGEADDRESSAWARE /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF); no _MOD_* switches, matching the shipped DLL
build.reproducibility: Not byte-reproducible: the PE header and debug directory carry build timestamps. Compare exports and behaviour, not hashes, across builds.
